import pytest
from media.preview import preview_endpoint

@pytest.mark.parametrize("url", [
    "https://trusted.com/image.jpg",   # allowed
    "http://malicious.com/evil.png",   # disallowed
])
def test_url_allowlist(client, url, mocker):
    # Mock the allowlisted function to return None for disallowed URLs
    mocker.patch('media.preview.allowlisted', side_effect=lambda u: u if u.startswith('https://trusted.com') else None)
    response = client.post('/preview', json={"url": url})
    if url.startswith('https://trusted.com'):
        assert response.status_code == 200
    else:
        assert response.status_code == 400
        assert b"URL not allowed" in response.data
